REVISED DESIGN PROPOSAL — NOT IMPLEMENTED OR APPROVED.

REVISED DESIGN PROPOSAL, NOT IMPLEMENTED OR APPROVED. Synthetic data only. Corrects the preservation defect in proposal-v3: the Cash-basis income, Cash-basis expenses, and Net income tiles and the Reconcile hero action already exist in apps/mobile/bookkeeping/DashboardScreen.tsx. They are not new, and they stay visible without any new query.

Layout, top to bottom (390x844 portrait, scrolls vertically; the five-tab bar is fixed):
1. App shell header: deep emerald band (#0E6B45) with the bar-mark, 'LLCBookKeepingPrivate' in white, and the existing Search action (48pt target). Shell behavior is unchanged.
2. Title block on white: business name (snapshot.business), 'Dashboard' title, and the existing helper copy 'Balances and totals come from this LLC’s persisted journal.' A period selector sits top-right with a dashed outline to mark it as PROPOSED. Its default and only pre-authorization state is 'All dates', which matches what the tiles show today.
3. Cash hero card (pale-green surface, navy type): 'Cash across bank and cash accounts', a large amount equal to the sum of balanceCents across bank and cash accounts (the existing cashBalance computation), and 'Current book balance, <todayLocalDate()>'. Two 48pt buttons: 'View accounts' navigates to Accounts, and 'Reconcile' navigates to Accounts. Both destinations are unchanged.
4. Three summary tiles in one row, each about 114pt wide, labels wrapping to two lines at 13pt or larger, no tiny columns: 'Cash-basis income' = snapshot.cashBasis.incomeCents, 'Cash-basis expenses' = snapshot.cashBasis.expenseCents, 'Net income' = snapshot.cashBasis.netIncomeCents. These come from the existing cashBasisForPeriod(database, businessId) call with no date bounds, so they cover all recorded dates. A 13pt caption below reads 'All recorded dates, from posted journal lines' so the scope is explicit. The tiles render today and need no new function.

REVISED DESIGN PROPOSAL — NOT IMPLEMENTED OR APPROVED.

Local books unavailable. Shown when the selected LLC's local database can't be opened safely, which fails closed. No tab bar. Database icon with an alert mark, title 'Local books are unavailable', an error detail card with the existing loadError text, and a mist note 'Your existing encrypted files have not been replaced.' Actions in order: 1 'Retry opening books' (primary, first focusable, existing retry); 2 'Restore from a backup file' (opens BOOT-03; landing directly on restore is proposed); 3 'Open storage and recovery tools'. Nothing can overwrite data without the explicit restore confirmation in BOOT-03. Privacy note: books are stored on this device, with no recovery server or key escrow. States: error, retrying, retry failed.
